upstream.revisionPolicy: The recipe is a published procedure, not a pinned upstream code revision; evaluation must pin exact TRL, PEFT, transformers and llama.cpp versions at run time before any result is comparable.

materialChanges: Fine-tunes LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M with TRL GRPO plus a LoRA adapter (rank 16, about 6M parameters, about 1.66% of the model) on roughly 500 structured-output samples over 100 training steps on a free-tier 16 GB GPU.

Defines three bounded [0,1] reward functions (json_format_reward, field_count_reward, schema_validation_reward) combined with weights 1.0/0.5/2.0, directly aligned with SZL governed JSON, YAML, tool-call and receipt contracts.
Augments training prompts so 40 percent request fenced code blocks and a disjoint 20 percent become top-level-array tasks, training form-following rather than raw-JSON-only behavior.
Merges the LoRA adapter into base weights and converts to BF16 GGUF for llama.cpp serving before evaluation.

Upstream reports overall IFStruct v1.0 improvement from 22.6 percent to 29.7 percent (JSON 18.0 to 31.9; bare list 16.6 to 29.7; YAML approximately unchanged) with the tuned model still below the upstream-reported Qwen3.5-2B 33.15 percent.

acceptance: Pin exact TRL, PEFT, transformers, llama.cpp and base-model revisions at evaluation time; the published recipe inherits no qualification.
Reproduce base and tuned IFStruct v1.0 runs on the same serving stack or record honest UNAVAILABLE; never transcribe upstream-reported scores as SZL measurements.

Unit-test the three reward functions on fixed non-secret fixtures including unparseable output, wrong-but-parseable form, exact and decaying field-count misses, and schema violations with partial credit gating.
Exercise the fenced-code-block versus raw-output instruction split and top-level-array item-count compliance.
Prove merged-adapter serving parity against the adapter-served checkpoint before any comparison claim.
Exercise failure, cancellation and rollback paths; keep training, model publication, provider routing and automatic promotion false until separate normal controls pass.

deduplication.result: material small-model schema-compliance post-training recipe: upstream-reported gains are recipe-illustrative and are not SZL measurements

alignment.claimBoundary: The recipe demonstrates that cheap task-specific GRPO rewards can improve small-model output-form compliance. It does not certify the upstream-reported benchmark scores, qualify any model for governed inference, or authorize production use.
